budget.note: staged; each stage reports before the next is funded; no hyperparameter search

checkpoints.v5a: per-tag F1 on held-in, both models scored on the SAME calibration rows. The span stage already measured: MRN 0.3857 -> 0.8966, health_plan 0.4696 -> 0.6667, but CVV 0.8780 -> 0.0581 and religion 0.8302 -> 0.1290 (single-corpus forgetting). The document stage over all 8 must restore that breadth or the span stage is net harmful and gets dropped.
checkpoints.v5b: vocabulary, dims, PCA variance retained, on-disk MB
checkpoints.v5c: micro F1 on held-in AND one-core p95 <= 10 ms fused — a hard stop
checkpoints.v5d: sealed measurement under both declared policies

feasibility.note: no ceiling available for the fused metric. CORRECTED: the first probe read 0.0000 on the five gated identifiers, but that was low support (2-12 gold docs), not absence of capability - re-measured on 85593_pii_trainset the as-shipped model scores SSN 0.5730, ITIN 0.8698, CVV 0.8780. Contextual signal is real (email 0.9464, zip 0.8946, names 0.74-0.76). What remains unevidenced is how much survives model2vec compression to a static token table.

plan.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4080 Laptop 12 GB for v5a/v5b; 1 CPU core for every published latency
plan.promotion: only if a declared gate is cleared
plan.revision: 2026-08-26 r2: latency budget raised 5 -> 10 ms on instruction; content read window set to 6,000 chars (same 1,024 tokens as 12,000, 2.7x cheaper)

stages.v5a: fine-tune kalyan-ks/ettin-68m-nemotron-pii: token head on the 85,593-doc span corpus, then a 61-way document head on all 8 corpora
stages.v5b: model2vec token distillation of the fine-tuned encoder
stages.v5c: document tagger over the static token embeddings, same 8 corpora
stages.v5d: fuse with projects/pii-scorecard-60/models/cascade_scorecard61, score on the 8 sealed corpora

plan.target: beat cascade_scorecard61 on micro_f1 (0.7299) without losing priority recall gates (25/55) or the one-core 10 ms fused budget
